metric_definitions.brier: mean sum of squared multiclass probability errors
metric_definitions.nll: mean negative log probability assigned to the true class
metric_definitions.probability_threshold_conformal: score=1-p_true; finite-sample higher quantile; include classes with probability at least 1-qhat
metric_definitions.aps_deterministic: non-randomized cumulative probability score including the candidate class; top-class fallback prevents empty APS sets
metric_definitions.selective_queue: retain confidence >= threshold; queue confidence < threshold
metric_definitions.temperature_scaling: one positive scalar fit by bounded NLL minimization on the probability-calibration half; conformal quantiles use only the disjoint conformal-calibration half
